entities.name: ANGPTL4
observations: siRNA-mediated suppression in TSCCA tongue squamous cell carcinoma cells reduced both cell migration and proliferation; suppression was confirmed by qRT-PCR and western blot. Invasion and cisplatin resistance were not significantly changed. [PMID:27505034]

entities.name: TSCCA
observations: Tongue squamous cell carcinoma model used to test ANGPTL4 siRNA; ANGPTL4 downregulation reduced migration and proliferation. [PMID:27505034]

entities.name: Tongue squamous cell carcinoma
observations: In a 2016 study, higher ANGPTL4 expression in 65 TSCC specimens was associated with advanced stage, lymph-node metastasis, increased microvessel density, and poorer survival; these are clinical associations rather than functional proof. [PMID:27505034]

entities.name: PMID:27505034
observations: Direct TSCCA experiment: ANGPTL4 siRNA reduced migration and proliferation; no rescue experiment or defined downstream mechanism was reported in the retrieved record.

entities.name: PMID:37169211
observations: In broader HNSCC models, ANGPTL4 promoted migration through NRP1, ABL1-dependent paxillin phosphorylation; NRP1 or ABL1 silencing and dasatinib blocked migration. ANGPTL4 downregulation inhibited tumor growth in an orthotopic floor-of-mouth model, but TSCC specificity was not established in the retrieved record.

entities.name: PMID:38763759
observations: In HNSCC-related models including HN13, HN6, HN4, HN12, and CAL27, amphiregulin-induced proliferation depended on ANGPTL4; p38 inhibition prevented proliferation and migration. The study was not clearly a TSCC-specific ANGPTL4 knockdown/rescue experiment.
